Clear the recorded checks

Source: R/checks.R
check_reset.Rd

Removes the checks recorded so far with check_result() and check_design(), so that the next check_summary() only counts new checks. It does not check or change any design or data; it only empties the list. A message says how many earlier checks were cleared and how many of them had passed.

Usage

check_reset()

Value

Invisibly, a tibble of the checks that were cleared.

Examples

check_reset()
#> Ready to start: no earlier checks to clear. The checks you run from now on will be counted together.
check_result("one equals one", 1 == 1)
#>   [OK]   one equals one
check_reset()
#> Earlier checks cleared (1 check, which passed). Ready to start new checks.
